prompt: Thiết kế UI UX app mobile iOS Android cho quản lý lịch hẹn. Chỉ thiết kế và prototype: dùng brand hiện tại, thiết kế đường đi đặt/hủy lịch, trạng thái lỗi và handoff. Không viết code app.
expected_outcomes: Platform-specific behavior mapped to shared task and brand
Source-linked decisions and native QA gaps explicit
Inspect UX wireframes before visual styling; current state, next action and recovery are clear
Compare representative compositions beyond color/copy; inspect actual captures for hierarchy, typography, purposeful density, media and seven visual signs
must_not: Implement app code or publish a store build
Copy one platform chrome onto the other
Accept broken task navigation because the screen looks polished
Claim beauty from JSON, screenshots not opened, or technical PASS
Force every screen into bento or add stock imagery solely to fill space
